comment: The workspace files the repository ships that a tool is NOT expected to open (a workspace.yaml under src/doc/examples or src/test/resources, or a workspace file the manual includes under another name). Every entry has `workspace` (the path from the root of the repository), `tools` (cli, editor, or both) and `reason` (why it is meant not to open). ShippedFilesTest.java (command line) and shipped-files.test.js (editor) read this file; an entry that names no file, or a file that opens although it is listed, fails them. Empty on purpose: every shipped workspace opens in both tools.
